prompt: Three birds were counted. One moves ashore. What now?
promptZh: 已數到三隻鳥，其中一隻移到岸上。現在該怎麼記？

options.text: Keep three; add an arrow to its first entry.
options.zh: 維持三隻，在牠第一次的記錄加箭頭。
options.whyZh: 總數維持三隻，在那隻鳥的原記錄加箭頭，不重複計數。

options.text: Count four; add an arrow to its first entry.
options.zh: 改記四隻，並在牠第一次的記錄加箭頭。
options.whyZh: 箭頭是對的，但同一隻鳥不能重複計入總數。

options.text: Keep three; delete its first entry.
options.zh: 維持三隻，刪掉牠第一次的記錄。
options.whyZh: 總數不增加是對的，但原記錄應加箭頭而不是刪除。

options.text: Count four; make a separate entry for the bank.
options.zh: 改記四隻，在岸邊另作一筆記錄。
options.whyZh: 那隻鳥已計過，另記會把牠重複算入。

explanationZh: 總數維持三隻，在那隻鳥的原記錄加箭頭，不重複計數。
evidence: If a bird moves from the water to the bank, mark its first entry with an arrow rather than counting it twice.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If a bird moves from the water to the bank, mark its first entry with an arrow rather than counting it twice.
